round1.title: Demand analyst (alt data)
round1.argument: Waitlisted share is 64.19% (+0.09 pp over 14 days, z = 0.08). Owned spaces are 5,976 vs 5,912 at Q3 (+1.1%). That implies leased revenue per space +0.04% and EPS +0.97%. Satellite night lights over the panel markets are +0.2% (7-day vs 30-day median). Snow in the northern strongholds is 46.0 cm quarter to date vs 33.7 cm a year ago.

round1.title: Valuation analyst (official data)
round1.argument: The run-rate model puts FY2026 revenue at ¥18,634 mn against guidance of ¥18,700 mn (-0.35%). At 4.5x operating leverage that is EPS -1.59%. Q4 model ¥4,824 mn, band ¥4,699–4,949 mn. Over the past month Paraca has moved -8.3% relative to Park24.

round1.title: Skeptic (measurement and risk)
round1.argument: The portal covers 14% of Paraca's 2,701 lots and has only 41 days of history, so its reliability weight is 0.215. 0 rent changes have been seen. Collection is healthy (2889/2889 runs ok). Nothing yet justifies moving from ¥1,991. Weather, satellite and attention signals are context only: none has been calibrated against revenue.
